rationale: Automatic charge source partitioning requests up to 32 splits for angular classes with at least 8192 primitives, independent of GPU model. Complete partials must fit the existing dead orbital-potential allocation; short work and insufficient capacity retain one partition. Explicit 1..64 overrides remain owner-frozen. No new allocation, screening, metric or precision policy is introduced. A100 endpoint ablations support removal of the SM 12.0 restriction; independent long-contraction, force, graph and bounded-capacity gates remain required. Retained A100, RTX 5090 and PRO 6000 observations do not establish performance on every GPU.
revisit_condition: Change the threshold or split count only with source-matched independent numerical and complete endpoint qualification, including small and larger work. Retain explicit rollback and constrained-capacity behavior.
